provenance.method: AI-assisted Mongolian translations matched to exact retained Japanese example sentences and checked against their existing English source. Japanese and English source text is preserved verbatim. Remaining apparent source-English mismatches are intentionally withheld pending review. This batch has not been independently human-reviewed.
provenance.source: OpenJLPT-distributed Tatoeba examples (Japanese/English source); Mongolian translations authored by OpenAI ChatGPT
